scope: Read-only source/clock/display review and synthetic tests only; no market data, detector, tuning, TradingView operation, notification or order.

exact_lines: alertcondition(earlySignal, "SPIKE 结构预警", "SPIKE 结构预警（不代表已确认） | {{exchange}}:{{ticker}} | {{interval}} | 预警收盘 {{close}}")
alertcondition(confirmedSignal, "SPIKE 结构确认", "SPIKE 结构确认 | {{exchange}}:{{ticker}} | {{interval}} | 实际确认收盘 {{close}}")
alertcondition(exitReference, "SPIKE 参考保护触及", "SPIKE 参考保护已触及 | {{exchange}}:{{ticker}} | {{interval}} | 已收盘确认，请查看参考价")

checks.oscillator_six_ma_and_risk_plots: Exact original lines, zero axis retained, no histograms added.

extracted_boolean_projection.results: All pass; includes unreachable Boolean combinations for robustness, not a market replay or Pine execution.

event_marker_conservation.anchor: plotshape(lowInterference and (earlySignal or confirmedSignal), title="原V3事件 · 历史锚点", style=shape.circle, location=location.belowbar, color=color.new(ink, 25), size=size.tiny, force_overlay=true, display=display.pane)
event_marker_conservation.same_bar_parent_child: One union anchor, separate unchanged data-window bits and alerts.
event_marker_conservation.current_bar_time_price: bar_index / time_close / close; parentBar and confirmationParentPrice are separately identified metadata.
event_marker_conservation.text_and_tooltip_limit: Shared max_labels_count=300 with risk/milestone tags; older text/tooltips can disappear, chart marker and data-window values remain.

plot_budget.expectation_explanation: 33 plot series + 2 original series colors (event dot/protection) + 1 input-color plotshape + 3 alertcondition + 1 barcolor. chart.fg_color is input color; constant/input colors and constant fill add no series count. Conservative bound charges every pane color plus the shape color and fill anyway.

tests.test_kind: Local static source contracts and synthetic display projection; not native Pine compilation

findings.initial_problem: Low mode used label.new only, so labels/circle markers could disappear beyond shared300 objects.
findings.resolution: Independent force_overlay plotshape preserves every original event union over loaded history. Shared text/tooltip limit is disclosed.

findings.detail: No native Pine compile or chart visual QA was performed. Static approval cannot establish real typography, collision handling, runtime resource count or TradingView availability.

Original candidates and alerts are unchanged. Less prominent supplemental labels are not filtered trades, improved precision, reduced alert count or validated same-trend deduplication. Main reference ownership is an existing signal-close display path, not actual position ownership.

sources.supports: 64 plot-count ceiling, objects do not count as plots, max_labels_count and series-color counts
chart.bg_color and chart.fg_color are input color values
